page.overview:
Who is Abu Zide?

{|cellspacing="1" cellpadding="3" border="0" align="center"

Pages for this subject as it appears in other canons:

Abu Zide was a legendary figure who was said to have traveled in a frigate which defied the Spacing Guild by riding "there" and back in a day. Used in this way, "there" derives from Fremen mythology, meaning "the land of the ruh-spirit, the alam al-mithal where all limitations are removed.". The Commentaries drew a parallel between Abu Zide and the Kwisatz Haderach, the latter being "one who can be two places simultaneously".
